short_description: ULTRACAM filters used at the Thai National Observatory

licence.scope: No owner statement found. The HiPERCAM/ULTRACAM/ULTRASPEC filter database (Vik Dhillon, University of Sheffield), which SVO cites (http://www.vikdhillon.staff.shef.ac.uk/ultracam/filters/filters.html, now https://vikdhillon.staff.shef.ac.uk/ultracam/filters/filters.html), and the ULTRACAM homepage carry no copyright, licence or credit text; the Sheffield university copyright pages concern the library and were not taken as covering this site. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: This work has made use of data obtained at the Thai National Observatory on Doi Inthanon, operated by NARIT.
acknowledgements.applies_to: all bands (NARIT asks for this line on publications using TNT data; its 2018 call page says nothing about filter curves)
